# Resources

Teaching materials and tools from my research, free to use and adapt.

## Brief measures of affective polarization: Shiny app {#brief-ap-app}

An interactive tool for choosing combinations of political parties that yield brief, valid measures of affective polarization in multi-party systems, based on CSES Module 5 data. It accompanies Kasper, Schumacher, & Bakker (2025) in the *European Journal of Political Research* ([DOI](https://doi.org/10.1111/1475-6765.70022)).

[Open the Shiny app](https://jakob-kasper.shinyapps.io/Brief_AP_Measures_Kasper_et_al_2025/){.btn-site}

## Data visualization workshop (ggplot2)

Slides from a workshop on data visualization in the social and cognitive sciences, taught with [Olaf Borghi](https://olafborghi.com/) at the IP-PAD network training day in Amsterdam, November 2025. It covers the plots that come up most in our fields, an introduction to ggplot2, and visualization best practices.

[Download slides (PDF)](datavis.pdf){.btn-site download="Kasper_Borghi_datavis_workshop.pdf"}
